name: Clean Authority
summary: Expensive by subtraction. Slow confident cuts, lots of empty space, black and white with one touch of gold, quiet film subtitles and one serif statement per point. Built to make a calm speaker the most credible voice in the feed.
best_for: High-ticket consultants, advisors, wealth and legal professionals, luxury real estate, executive coaches and premium agencies. 30-90 second point-of-view pieces where trust matters more than hype.
why_it_works: In a feed of loud edits, stillness is the pattern interrupt: a calm contrarian line with one gold word stops the scroll on contrast alone. Long 3-6s holds signal confidence and let the viewer judge the person, which builds trust. A new idea every 5-8s gives the brain time to agree with each point. Whole-phrase subtitles read like film, and the single color teaches the eye exactly where the important word is.

preview.caption_sample: Clarity is the rarest skill in business.
preview.motion_sample: On black, three lines of spaced serif capitals rise slowly through a mask beside an empty frame, a thin gold rule draws underneath, and a quiet subtitle fades in at the bottom.
